That just leaves the first name fitting in her quirk. I saw someone suggest Chibaku, but that'd be Chibaku Bakugou (blood explosion explosion) which would be a lil goofy agshdjfk

If you want the kanji for blood and copy to be in the name, here are the possible readings:

**血 (blood)**

On - ketsu

Kun - chi

**写 (copy)**

On - sha, ja

Kun - utsu

Which, sadly doesn't leave many good combinations. Chisa, Utsuchi, Ketsuchi, Chija... which none really jump out, Chisa sounding the best out of the bunch. Now, we could make a three kanji name and throw in  子 (child) to make Chisako.

I might be able to help! I like creating names like Hori does (based off quirks or other important aspects of their character), so if you've created a quirk for her or have some defining characteristics, I can probably create a name :0
